shortDescription: Manage the HPE Nimble Storage volumes

options.name: agent_type
options.description: External management agent type.

options.name: app_uuid
options.description: Application identifier of volume.

options.name: block_size
options.description: Size in bytes of blocks in the volume.

options.name: cache_pinned
options.description: If set to true, all the contents of this volume are kept in flash cache.

options.name: caching
options.description: Indicate caching the volume is enabled.

options.name: change_name
options.description: Change name of the existing source volume.

options.name: clone
options.description: Whether this volume is a clone. Use this attribute in combination with name and snapshot to create a clone by setting clone = true.

options.name: dedupe
options.description: Indicate whether dedupe is enabled.

options.name: description
options.description: Text description of volume.

options.name: destination
options.description: Name of the destination pool where the volume is moving to.

options.name: encryption_cipher
options.description: The encryption cipher of the volume.

options.name: folder
options.description: Name of the folder holding this volume.

options.name: force
options.description: Forcibly offline, reduce size or change read-only status a volume.

options.name: force_vvol
options.description: Forcibly move a virtual volume.

options.name: host
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage IP address.

options.name: iscsi_target_scope
options.description: This indicates whether volume is exported under iSCSI Group Target or iSCSI volume target. This attribute is only meaningful to iSCSI system.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit on the volume's mapped usage, expressed as a percentage of the volume's size.

options.name: limit_iops
options.description: IOPS limit for this volume.

options.name: limit_mbps
options.description: Throughput limit for this volume in MB/s.

options.name: metadata
options.description: User defined key-value pairs that augment an volume's attributes. List of key-value pairs. Keys must be unique and non-empty. When creating an object, values must be non-empty. When updating an object, an empty value causes the corresponding key to be removed.

options.name: move
options.description: Move a volume to different pool.

options.name: multi_initiator
options.description: For iSCSI volume target, this flag indicates whether the volume and its snapshots can be accessed from multiple initiators at the same time.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the source volume.

options.name: online
options.description: Online state of volume, available for host initiators to establish connections.

options.name: owned_by_group
options.description: Name of group that currently owns the volume.

options.name: parent
options.description: Name of parent volume.

options.name: password
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage password.

options.name: perf_policy
options.description: Name of the performance policy. After creating a volume, performance policy for the volume can only be changed to another performance policy with same block size.

options.name: pool
options.description: Name associated with the pool in the storage pool table.

options.name: read_only
options.description: Volume is read-only.

options.name: size
options.description: Volume size in megabytes. Size is required for creating a volume but not for cloning an existing volume.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Base snapshot name. This attribute is required together with name and clone when cloning a volume with the create operation.

options.name: state
options.description: The volume operations.

options.name: thinly_provisioned
options.description: Set volume's provisioning level to thin.

options.name: username
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage user name.

options.name: volcoll
options.description: Name of volume collection of which this volume is a member. Use this attribute in update operation to associate or dissociate volumes with or from volume collections. When associating, set this attribute to the name of the volume collection. When dissociating, set this attribute to empty string.
